Requirement: A person with a confirmed email creates a hotel account in one step.
Given: a signed-in user with a confirmed email and no hotel
When: they submit business name, country and property name
Then: a tenant, a 30-day trial, one property with country defaults, and the System Administrator and General Manager roles exist for them

Requirement: Signup is refused for an unconfirmed email and for a user who already belongs to a hotel.
Given: a user whose email is not confirmed
When: they try to create a hotel
Then: the request is refused with E_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED; a user who already has a hotel gets E_ALREADY_HAS_HOTEL

Requirement: One hotel can never see or change another hotel's data.
Given: two hotels with data
When: a user of hotel B queries or calls functions with hotel A's ids
Then: no rows come back, writes are refused, and functions answer E_PERM or E_NOT_FOUND
Built by: row-level security on every table; tenant_id on every row

Requirement: A new property is seeded from its country template (currency, timezone, tax lines, payment methods, charge codes).
Given: a hotel signs up in Nigeria
When: the property is created
Then: it uses naira and Africa/Lagos with service charge, VAT 7.5% and a state levy line at 0%, all marked unverified; other countries get no guessed taxes

Requirement: A trial ends automatically and the hotel becomes read-only.
Given: a hotel whose trial end date has passed
When: the daily clock runs
Then: the subscription is Expired, the change is in the subscription history, and the hotel can read but not create

Requirement: A read-only hotel can still settle and check out guests already in house.
Given: an expired hotel with a guest in house who owes money
When: staff post a payment and check the guest out
Then: both succeed; new bookings and charges are refused with E_READ_ONLY

Requirement: Plan limits on rooms, properties and users stop new creation and never delete anything.
Given: a hotel on a plan of one room
When: staff add a second room, property or user
Then: the action is refused with E_PLAN_LIMIT; existing data is untouched
Notes: Adding a property: System Administrator and General Manager (ADM-002), within plans.max_properties.

Requirement: Platform staff activate, suspend, change plan or close a hotel by hand, with a reason, and every change is logged.
Given: a hotel whose invoice was paid outside the system
When: platform staff activate it with a paid-until date
Then: it becomes Active, works again, and the change appears in the subscription history
Notes: Platform console /platform (wave 2 item 2): extend trial, activate or extend paid period, suspend, change plan, cancel; each with a reason, logged in subscription_history with the operator.

Requirement: Platform staff see tenants and subscriptions but no guest, reservation or financial data.
Given: a platform user
When: they query guests, folios or reservations
Then: they get no rows
Built by: platform_list_tenants (hotel account data only); operators have no hotel, so row-level security shows them no hotel rows
Notes: Corrected 6 Oct 2026: before wave 2 item 2 there was no platform staff role at all; the earlier "Built, no tagged test" was wrong.

Requirement: Time-boxed support access with the hotel's consent: the operator asks with a reason, the hotel's administrator says yes for 1 to 72 hours or no, can stop it at any time, and every step is in the hotel audit log. The support view is read-only and holds no guest, booking, money or contact data.
Given: a platform operator needs to help a hotel
When: they ask for support access with a reason and the hotel says yes
Then: they can open a read-only support view until the time ends or the hotel stops it; the hotel is told and every step is audited
Notes: Database done 8 Oct 2026. Screens for the hotel (Admin) and the operator (platform console) follow. New permission adm.support.manage reaches System Administrator and General Manager only.

Requirement: A hotel can cancel its own subscription and stays read-only afterwards.
Given: a hotel administrator
When: they cancel the subscription with a reason
Then: status becomes Cancelled and, when no paid period remains, the hotel is read-only

Requirement: Subscription billing through a payment provider (Paystack first). A hotel picks a plan and pays online; the price comes from the database; the provider result activates the plan once, only when the amount and currency match; failed payments show to platform operators. Hotels pay from the Subscription tab; Paystack calls a signed webhook.
Given: a hotel administrator on a plan with a price
When: they start a payment and the provider confirms it
Then: "the plan becomes active for a month or a year, a resent event changes nothing, a wrong amount activates nothing"
Built by: start_subscription_payment, billing_apply_event, platform_set_plan_price, platform_failed_payments, billing_options, paystack webhook gate
Notes: Needs PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY and the webhook address set in Paystack. Prices are empty until A16 is decided.

Requirement: Platform operators are separate sign-ins that belong to no hotel, added only by the database owner; the platform console and every platform function need the operator list and a session that passed two-step sign-in.
Given: a platform operator signed in with password only
When: they open the console or call a platform function
Then: it is refused until they confirm with their authenticator app; hotel accounts are always refused

Requirement: A hotel administrator adds staff to the hotel.
Given: an administrator and a new auth user created by an Edge Function
When: the administrator registers the user
Then: the user joins the hotel; a person who already belongs to a hotel cannot be taken over
Built by: register_invited_user (the Edge Function creates the auth user and sends the invite)
Notes: Invites are sent by a Vercel server function (not an Edge Function).

Requirement: Only administrators assign roles, per property or hotel-wide; the last administrator cannot be removed.
Given: a hotel with one System Administrator
When: that person is removed or disabled
Then: the change is refused with E_LAST_ADMIN; platform roles can never be assigned by a hotel

Requirement: A disabled user loses all access immediately.
Given: a cashier who leaves the company
When: an administrator disables the user
Then: every action the user tries is refused with E_PERM

Requirement: Custom roles cannot hold more than their creator holds.
Given: an administrator without payment rights
When: they add fin.payment.post to a custom role
Then: the change is refused with E_ESCALATION; system roles cannot be edited

Requirement: Limit-based permissions (grant level L) use a per-role amount; no limit means zero.
Given: a role with level L on discount and a limit of 5,000
When: the user applies a discount of 8,000
Then: the discount waits for approval

Requirement: The audit trail cannot be changed or deleted by anyone, and is visible to permitted roles only.
Given: audit events exist
When: anyone, including the database owner, updates or deletes one
Then: the change is refused with E_IMMUTABLE

Requirement: Sensitive actions require a reason and write an audit event with actor, time, before and after.
Given: a sensitive action (cancel, rate override, refund, block, reopen, override condition)
When: it is performed
Then: a reason is required and an audit event is written

Requirement: Staff get in-app notifications for approvals, tasks and exceptions, and can mark them read.
Given: an approval is requested
When: the requester submits it
Then: users holding the approve permission get a notification; each user sees only their own

Requirement: Authorised users export data.
Given: an authorised user
When: they export a report
Then: a file is produced and the export is audited
Built by: export_data (rpt.export: System Administrator, General Manager, Accountant) returns bookings, ledger rows or guests for one property and at most a year, and writes an audit row (action export: who, what, which property, how many rows); the Export tab on Reports downloads it as CSV through src/lib/exports.functions.ts
Notes: export_data (audited), Reports > Export.

Requirement: Property profile can be edited, but the business date and base currency cannot.
Given: a property with postings
When: an administrator edits the profile
Then: name, contact, rollover time and inspection setting change; business date and base currency are refused

Requirement: Room types with occupancy limits and an overbooking allowance.
Given: an administrator
When: they add a room type
Then: it appears in availability and booking
Notes: Corrected 6 Oct 2026: room types and occupancy limits (save_room_type, max adults and children; Setup, Room types) exist; the overbooking allowance does not exist anywhere in the app.

Requirement: Room inventory per property; rooms can be retired but never deleted while in use.
Given: an administrator
When: they add rooms
Then: they start Ready and Vacant and count towards inventory; condition and occupancy cannot be written by hand
Notes: A room cannot be retired while a guest is in it ([E_ROOM_OCCUPIED], checked first) or while upcoming bookings are assigned to it ([E_ROOM_BOOKED], names up to 5 booking numbers): confirmed, or tentative with an unexpired hold, from the business date forward (decisions of 6 Oct 2026). Retiring a room that is already retired is safe to repeat; renaming and floor changes still work.

Requirement: Rate plans with prices by room type, date range and weekday, and policies for cancellation, no-show and deposit.
Given: a rate plan with a cancellation rule of one night inside two days
When: a guest cancels one day before arrival
Then: one night is charged

Requirement: Tax lines with rate, base (net or net plus prior taxes), applicable revenue groups and a verified flag.
Given: service charge 10% then VAT 7.5% on price plus service charge
When: a charge of 10,000 is posted
Then: tax lines of 1,000 and 825 are posted; inclusive prices solve back to the same net

Requirement: Charge codes and payment methods per property.
Given: a property
When: staff post a charge or a payment
Then: only active codes and methods of that property are accepted

Requirement: Exchange rates per property per day, entered by hand.
Given: USD at 1,500
When: a guest pays USD 10
Then: the row stores amount, currency, rate 1,500 and a base amount of 15,000; a currency without a rate is refused

Requirement: Inspection can be switched off per property.
Transition / rule refs: Transition: Room Condition Cleaning to Ready
Given: inspection_required is false
When: an attendant completes a task
Then: the room is Ready at once and the task closes itself

Requirement: Availability is calculated per room type and night from sellable rooms less held bookings.
Given: three standard rooms and three bookings for a night
When: staff search that night
Then: availability is zero; approved blocks reduce sellable rooms; dirty rooms do not

Requirement: Create a reservation for one room type and rate plan, priced night by night.
Given: a room type with a rate
When: staff create a two-night booking
Then: nights are priced from the rate plan, a folio is opened, and the same idempotency key returns the same booking

Requirement: A sold-out room type cannot be booked, and occupancy and stay-length limits are enforced.
Given: a sold-out night
When: staff book it
Then: the booking is refused with E_UNAVAILABLE; too many guests gives E_OCCUPANCY; past arrival gives E_DATES
Built by: assert_available (advisory lock per property and room type)

Requirement: Modify dates, room type, rate plan or guest count before check-in; the stay is repriced and inventory follows.
Given: a confirmed booking
When: staff shorten it by a night
Then: the total is repriced and the night is released; an in-house booking cannot be edited this way

Requirement: A tentative booking holds inventory until its hold expires, then is released at the next roll; confirming ends the hold.
Given: a tentative booking with a 1-hour hold
When: the hold passes and the roll runs
Then: the booking is cancelled with reason 'Hold expired' and inventory is free

Requirement: Cancel with a reason; the fee follows the rate plan; only a permitted user can waive it.
Given: a booking inside the free-cancellation window
When: staff cancel it
Then: one night's fee is posted to the folio; a cancellation outside the window is free; waiving the fee needs res.rate.override

Requirement: No-show can be marked by hand or by the automatic roll, with the fee from the rate plan.
Given: a confirmed booking whose arrival date is today
When: staff mark it no-show, or the roll runs
Then: the booking is No-show, the fee is posted once and the room hold is released; a guest not yet due cannot be marked

Requirement: Reinstate a cancelled or no-show booking when inventory allows.
Given: a cancelled booking with the room type still available
When: a manager reinstates it with a reason
Then: it is Confirmed again and its folio reopens; if the type is full it is refused

Requirement: Rate override needs its own permission and a reason, and is audited.
Given: a front desk officer without the permission
When: they set a custom rate
Then: the request is refused; a manager with a reason sets the rate and the override is audited

Requirement: A deposit rule on the rate plan sets the deposit required.
Given: a rate plan asking for 50% deposit
When: a two-night booking is made
Then: the deposit required is half the stay and the guarantee type is deposit

Requirement: Corporate business is a booking source plus a free-text company name plus a corporate rate plan; no company entity in R1.
Given: a booking for a company
When: staff choose source Corporate and type the company name
Then: the company name is saved with the booking and reports can filter on it

Requirement: A group booking is several one-room reservations sharing a group record.
Given: a group with a contact and dates
When: staff create reservations for the group
Then: each reservation links to the group; each room is booked and assigned on its own
Notes: save_group_booking exists and the booking form picks a group; there is no screen to create a group.

Requirement: Additional guests and an arrival-ready flag on a booking.
Given: a confirmed booking
When: staff add a second guest and set arrival-ready
Then: both are saved; arrival-ready never changes the status
Notes: set_arrival_ready exists; no screen shows the flag yet (skipped 6 Oct 2026).

Requirement: Arrivals due today or overdue, with guest, room type, guarantee and assigned room.
Given: a confirmed booking due today
When: staff open the board
Then: it appears with the guest's name; after check-in it leaves the list

Requirement: In-house guests with room, departure and balance; overdue departures flagged.
Given: a guest in house
When: staff open the board
Then: the guest appears with room number and balance

Requirement: Check-in guards: confirmed booking, arrival date reached, ID recorded, registration accepted, room ready and free, deposit paid.
Given: a booking due today
When: staff check the guest in without ID, or into a dirty or occupied room, or without the deposit
Then: each is refused with its own code; with everything in place the reservation is Checked In, the stay In-House and the room Occupied
Notes: The check-in and walk-in screens force the registration card tick; a direct database call that omits it is not refused (decision 6 Oct 2026). Drawn signature later.

Requirement: Walk-in check-in creates the booking and checks in in one step.
Given: a free ready room
When: staff check in a walk-in guest
Then: a confirmed walk-in booking is created and the guest is checked in

Requirement: Assign a room before arrival; two overlapping stays can never hold the same room.
Transition / rule refs: Transition: Room Assignment none to Held
Given: a room held for a booking
When: staff assign it to an overlapping booking
Then: the database refuses with E_ROOM_TAKEN; a room of the wrong type is refused with E_ROOM_TYPE

Requirement: Move a guest to another room; the old room turns dirty with a turnover task; the stay and folio carry over.
Transition / rule refs: Transition: Room Assignment Active to Ended
Given: a guest in house and a ready room
When: staff move the guest with a reason
Then: one active room at a time, old room dirty and vacant, new room occupied, task created; a dirty target is refused

Requirement: A move to a different room type reprices from tonight; a complimentary upgrade keeps the rate and needs its own permission.
Given: a guest booked in a standard room
When: a manager upgrades them free
Then: the booked rate stays but the night counts against deluxe inventory; a front desk officer is refused
Notes: Dearer room type: front desk charges the new rate; keeping it needs fo.upgrade.complimentary (SYSADMIN, GM, FOM), audited.

Requirement: Extend or shorten a stay in house; extension checks inventory, the room and blocks.
Given: a guest in house and the room promised to another guest
When: staff extend the stay
Then: the extension is refused with E_ROOM_TAKEN; a free extension prices the new night; shortening removes unused nights

Requirement: Check-out needs a zero balance and no credit, or an approved exception; open folios stay open for collection.
Given: a guest who owes money
When: staff try to check them out
Then: it is refused until a different person approves an exception; then the stay closes, the invoice shows the balance and the folio stays open; a credit balance must be refunded first

Requirement: Check-out sets the room Dirty and Vacant and creates a turnover task; leaving early releases the unused nights.
Transition / rule refs: Transition: Room Condition Ready to Dirty
Given: a guest checks out
When: the check-out completes
Then: the room is Dirty and Vacant, a turnover task exists, the folio closes and an invoice is issued

Requirement: Undo a check-out on the same business date.
Transition / rule refs: Transition: Checked Out to Checked In
Given: a guest checked out today and the room not yet being cleaned
When: a manager undoes it with a reason
Then: the guest is in house, the room occupied, the task cancelled and the folio open; a front desk officer is refused

Requirement: Void a check-in on the same business date when no charges are posted.
Given: a check-in made in error today
When: a manager voids it with a reason
Then: the stay is Voided, the booking Confirmed, the room vacant and held; the guest can be checked in again

Requirement: Room board shows each room as occupied, vacant by condition, out of order or out of service.
Given: a guest in a room
When: staff open the room board
Then: the room shows occupied

Requirement: One guest profile per person across stays; search by name, phone, email or ID number.
Given: guests exist
When: front desk searches by surname
Then: the guest is found; a role without guest.view finds nothing

Requirement: ID documents are stored apart and shown only to roles that may see them.
Given: a recorded passport number
When: a reservation officer opens the guest
Then: they see the profile but no ID documents

Requirement: Personal data never appears in audit records; only the names of changed fields do.
Transition / rule refs: Rule: Personal data and the ledger
Given: a phone number is changed
When: the audit trail is read
Then: it says the phone changed, not what the number was

Requirement: Merge duplicate guest profiles; history moves to the kept profile.
Given: two profiles for one person
When: a manager merges them with a reason
Then: reservations and folios point to the kept profile and the duplicate is emptied

Requirement: Anonymise a guest on request; the ledger and stay history stay intact.
Transition / rule refs: Rule: Personal data and the ledger
Given: a guest with no current or upcoming stay
When: a manager anonymises them
Then: name, contact and documents are removed and cannot be restored from the app; reservations remain

Requirement: Feedback and complaints logged against a guest.
Given: a guest complaint
When: staff log it
Then: it is saved with the guest and shown on the profile

Requirement: Room condition and occupancy are separate, are set only by the system or a controlled action, and cannot be written by hand.
Given: any user
When: they try to update condition or occupancy directly
Then: the update is refused with permission denied

Requirement: Out-of-order and out-of-service blocks; a request from maintenance needs approval, an approver's own request does not.
Given: a maintenance officer requests a block
When: a manager approves it
Then: the room leaves availability for those nights; a requested block does not; releasing returns it

Requirement: A block cannot cover a night a guest is assigned, and cannot oversell the room type.
Given: a room assigned to a guest or the last room of a type
When: staff block it
Then: the block is refused with E_ROOM_TAKEN or E_OVERSOLD

Requirement: A supervisor can override a room's condition with a reason; it is audited.
Given: a dirty room a manager has inspected
When: the manager marks it ready with a reason
Then: the room is Ready and the override is in the audit trail; front desk is refused

Requirement: Check-out and room moves create a turnover task; the board lists open tasks.
Given: a guest checks out
When: the check-out completes
Then: a pending turnover task exists for the room; an older unfinished task is superseded

Requirement: Assign, start and complete cleaning tasks; an attendant sees only their own tasks.
Transition / rule refs: Transition: Dirty to Cleaning to Awaiting Inspection
Given: a pending task
When: a supervisor assigns it and the attendant starts and completes it
Then: the room goes Cleaning then Awaiting Inspection; an attendant cannot start another person's task

Requirement: Inspection passes to Ready or fails with a reason and goes to rework.
Transition / rule refs: Transition: Awaiting Inspection to Ready / Cleaning
Given: a completed task
When: the inspector fails it with a reason
Then: the room is Dirty, the task is in rework and the attendant is notified; a pass makes it Ready

Requirement: Nobody inspects their own cleaning.
Given: a supervisor who cleaned a room
When: they inspect it
Then: it is refused with E_SOD

Requirement: Stayover cleaning tasks are planned at the roll for guests staying on.
Given: a guest in house who stays another night
When: the roll runs
Then: a stayover task exists for the new day; a departing guest gets none

Requirement: Lost and found items are logged and tracked to return or disposal.
Given: a found item
When: housekeeping logs it
Then: it is saved with room, date and status

Requirement: An attendant logs minibar use from the room. The database prices it from the hotel price list. Front desk confirms before the charge posts to the folio.
Given: a guest in house and a minibar price list
When: an attendant logs 2 water and 1 cola, then front desk confirms
Then: a request for the priced total waits open, a repeat with the same key makes no second request, the attendant cannot confirm, and the confirmed charge posts once

Requirement: Tickets move from open to assigned, in progress, waiting, resolved and closed; waiting needs a reason.
Given: a ticket
When: it is assigned, started, paused with a reason, resumed and resolved
Then: each step follows the allowed path and a ticket assigned to someone else cannot be started by another person

Requirement: The person who resolved a ticket cannot close it; closing releases its room block.
Given: a resolved ticket with a room block
When: its resolver tries to close it, then a supervisor does
Then: the first is refused with E_SOD; the second closes it and releases the block

Requirement: Tickets can be reopened or cancelled, each with a reason.
Given: a resolved ticket
When: a maintenance officer reopens it or cancels it
Then: the status changes and the reason is audited; housekeeping cannot cancel

Requirement: Staff add up to 5 photos to a maintenance ticket from the phone. Photos are private, and uploads and views are audited by ids only.
Given: an open ticket
When: an attendant adds a photo, others view it, a supervisor removes it
Then: only people tied to the ticket can add or view, the limit is 5, a removed photo is cleaned from storage, and a finished ticket takes no new photos

Requirement: Guest requests are captured, assigned, progressed and completed.
Given: a guest in house
When: staff log a request and it is assigned, started and completed
Then: it is tied to the guest's room and finishes once

Requirement: A chargeable request posts its charge, with tax, to the folio when completed.
Given: a chargeable laundry request of 3,000
When: it is completed
Then: 3,000 plus tax is posted once to the guest's folio

Requirement: Charges post with their tax lines; prices can include or exclude tax; the remainder of a rounding goes on the last tax line.
Given: service charge 10% and VAT 7.5%
When: a charge of 10,000 or an inclusive 11,825 is posted
Then: the folio owes 11,825 with a net of 10,000 either way

Requirement: Payments and deposits are recorded against a folio with a method; payments are taken outside the system in R1.
Given: a folio with a balance
When: staff record a cash payment or a deposit
Then: the balance falls; a role without the matching permission is refused

Requirement: Foreign-currency postings store the amount, currency, exchange rate and base amount.
Given: USD 10 at 1,500
When: it is posted
Then: the row shows the rate and 15,000 in the base currency; the amount must respect the currency's decimals

Requirement: A discount within the user's limit posts at once; above the limit it waits for an approver who is not the requester.
Given: a front desk limit of 5,000
When: they apply 3,000 then 8,000
Then: the first posts; the second is pending, does not change the balance and can be approved or rejected (with a reason) by a manager

Requirement: Adjustments, reversals and refunds always need a second person and stay within the approver's limit.
Given: an adjustment of 50,000 requested by a cashier
When: a manager with a 20,000 limit approves
Then: it is refused with E_LIMIT; a senior approver can; nobody approves their own request
Built by: request_adjustment, request_reversal, request_refund, decide_approval; check constraint approver_is_not_requester

Requirement: A posted transaction is never edited or deleted; corrections are linked reversal, adjustment or refund rows.
Given: a posted charge
When: anyone, including the database owner, changes or deletes it
Then: the change is refused with E_IMMUTABLE; a reversal posts a linked row (with its tax lines) and a charge reverses only once

Requirement: A refund cannot exceed the credit on the folio.
Given: a folio with a small credit
When: staff request a bigger refund
Then: it is refused with E_REFUND_LIMIT; a refund within the credit is approved and pays out

Requirement: Repeating the same request cannot double post (idempotency keys).
Given: a charge posted with a key
When: the same request arrives again
Then: the second returns the first and the balance is unchanged

Requirement: Move a posted charge, with its tax, to another folio of the same booking; revenue does not change.
Given: a charge on the guest folio
When: a manager transfers it to a company folio
Then: the target owes the charge and tax, the source is relieved, the total is unchanged and the charge moves once

Requirement: Split folios per reservation.
Given: a reservation
When: staff add a Company folio
Then: charges can be posted to either folio and check-out settles both

Requirement: A folio closes only at a zero balance and reopens only for the accountant with a reason; a closed folio takes no postings.
Given: a settled folio
When: it is closed and then a posting is attempted
Then: the posting is refused with E_FOLIO_CLOSED; reopening needs the permission and a reason and is audited

Requirement: Invoices and receipts are numbered documents built from posted rows; they cannot be changed once issued.
Given: a settled folio
When: an invoice is issued
Then: the total, tax and balance match the folio and the invoice cannot be edited; interim receipts have their own number series

Requirement: Balances are calculated from posted rows and never stored; pending approvals do not change them.
Given: a pending discount
When: the balance is read
Then: it is unchanged until the approval posts

Requirement: Every posting takes the open business date, and a past date is refused.
Given: a posting for a past date
When: it is inserted
Then: it is refused with E_DATE

Requirement: Folio visibility follows the role: managers see all folios, a reservation officer sees only those of their own bookings.
Given: a reservation officer
When: they read a colleague's folio
Then: they see nothing; they can still take a deposit

Requirement: Cashier shifts: a cashier opens a shift with a float, takes payments, counts each payment method at the end; the database works out expected and difference; a manager reconciles (never the closer). A hotel can require an open shift before payments.
Given: a cashier with an open shift who took cash and card payments
When: they close the shift with their counts
Then: the difference per method is worked out, a note is needed for a difference, and a manager reconciles it
Built by: open_cashier_shift, close_cashier_shift, reconcile_cashier_shift, cashier_shift_summary, list_cashier_shifts, set_cashier_shift_required, stamp_cashier_shift
Notes: Cashier shift page built (open, close with counts, review, reconcile). Not covered by a browser test yet. New permission fin.shift.reconcile goes to built-in roles only.

Requirement: The business date rolls automatically at each property's cut-off time.
Given: a property whose cut-off has passed
When: the scheduler runs
Then: the date advances one day, up to three days per run; the roll is logged

Requirement: At the roll, each guest in house is charged the night's room rate and tax exactly once.
Given: two guests in house
When: the roll runs
Then: each folio gets one room charge for the closing date, with tax; running it again for the same night cannot repeat it

Requirement: A guest still in house past departure is charged and extended a night if the room allows; otherwise managers are told.
Given: a guest due out today who is still in house
When: the roll runs
Then: the departure moves one day and the night is charged

Requirement: A failed roll changes nothing and notifies managers; other properties are not blocked.
Given: a property whose roll fails
When: the scheduler runs
Then: its date is unchanged and managers get a notification

Requirement: Night audit flags list what is still open before the day closes: open cashier shifts (blocking), unreconciled differences, guests past departure, arrivals not checked in. The flags do not stop the date rolling yet.
Given: R2
Notes: Flags shown in Admin, Business date. The gate that stops the roll while a blocking flag is open is not built.

Requirement: A same-day arrival and departure: decide whether a night or day-use charge applies.
Given: a guest checks in and out on the same business date
When: they leave before the roll
Then: today no room charge is made; the desk can post a manual charge
Notes: Decided by Peter on 30 Sep 2026 (answer 5) and confirmed on 1 Oct 2026: same-day stays are charged one night; a manager can waive it with a reason.

Requirement: Occupancy, ADR and RevPAR use one definition: rooms sold over rooms available (out-of-order rooms excluded), revenue net of tax.
Given: a closed day
When: management opens the KPI view
Then: occupancy, ADR and RevPAR equal sold, revenue and available as defined; tax is shown apart

Requirement: Live operations views: arrivals, in-house, room board, housekeeping board.
Given: activity in the hotel
When: staff open the operations dashboard
Then: the views return only rows the user may see

Requirement: Every reported figure traces to ledger rows or operational records.
Given: a daily figure
When: an auditor recomputes it from folio_transactions
Then: the figures agree

Requirement: Report screens (occupancy trend, revenue by group, outstanding balances, cancellation and no-show rates).
Given: a date range
